description: Scores a Virtuals ACP agent's job-readiness (0-100) and lists ranked issues with likely causes and acp CLI fixes. Use when an ACP agent is getting no jobs or ranking poorly; it is not a token, market, or contract tool; paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

agent.description: ACP agent UUID or its 0x EVM wallet address.

symptom.description: Optional symptom, such as no jobs, not in search, jobs expire, or setBudget fails.

name: acp_agent_repair_check

issues.description: severity, area, problem, likelyCause, fix (acp CLI command or dashboard step)

title: ACP Agent Repair Check
